steps.title: Compustat Global country indexes (names only)
Compustat Global index coverage (dates/counts only)
steps.code:
d=sql("select gvkeyx, min(datadate) a, max(datadate) b, count(*) n, count(bkvlps) nbv, count(epsx12) neps, count(prccmdivusd) ntr from comp.g_idx_mth group by gvkeyx having count(*)>240")
out(len(d),'indexes with 20+ years'); out(d.to_string(index=False)[:20000])

steps.title: World Indices currencies (counts only)
steps.code:
d=sql("select fic, country, currency, count(*) n, min(date) a, max(date) b from wrdsapps_windices.mwcountryreturns group by 1,2,3 order by 1")
out(d.to_string(index=False))
